qa_pairs.question: What should I check first if the fuel pump is not running?
qa_pairs.answer: Check if the pump fuse is okay. If the fuse is not okay, replace the pump fuse.

qa_pairs.question: How do I check the power supply to the fuel pump?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off plug on fuel pump, connect voltmeter (M 1) between wires in plug, start engine. Voltmeter should show battery voltage.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if the fuel pump has good power supply but still isn't working?
How do I test the brown wire ground connection?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect ohmmeter (M 06) between brown wire on disconnected plug and ground. Ohmmeter should show approx. 0 ohm.

qa_pairs.question: What should the resistance value be when checking the brown wire ground?
How do I check the green/violet wire voltage?
qa_pairs.answer: Pull off plug on control relay, connect ohmmeter (M 06) between conn. 87a on disconnected control relay plug and green/violet wire on disconnected pump plug. Ohmmeter should show approx. 0 ohm.

qa_pairs.question: What should I do if the brown wire ground check shows the resistance value is not okay?
What should I do if the green/violet wire voltage check shows the resistance value is not okay?
What connector should I use to check the green/violet wire voltage?
qa_pairs.answer: Connect between conn. 87a on disconnected control relay plug and green/violet wire on disconnected pump plug.
